title: 2026-04-21 每日运势
body:
Today's 乙卯 (Yi Mao) energy carries the gentleness of spring shoots breaking soil—soft yet unstoppable.

**Seeds to Plant:**
• **Gentle Initiatives**: Start projects that require patience rather than force. Yin Wood favors the steady vine over the crashing axe.
• **Quiet Networking**: The Rabbit invites one-on-one conversations. Plant relationship seeds through deep listening, not broadcasting.
• **Micro-Skills**: Twenty minutes learning something new today compounds like bamboo roots—invisible now, explosive later.

**Spatial Breath**: Open east-facing windows this morning if possible. Let the 生气 (Sheng Qi, growth energy) circulate through your space as you begin.

**Carry this**: You don't need to see the full tree to trust the seed. Today's energy asks only for the courage to begin, not the burden of finishing.

The path unfolds as you walk it.
